rows.source: distantBanjo/5 19/farmer 5 23 0 Pierre 5 17 2 Gus 5 19 0 Jodi 5 21 0 Marnie 10 20 0 Robin 2 24 3 Evelyn 9 26 1/hostMail MSB_Pierre/skippable/pause 3000/speak Pierre "Gus, I have just the thing for you..."/speak Gus "I'm all ears."/speak Pierre "It's a bundle of locally sourced, organic, heirloom veggies...#$b#These are hand picked and sorted, to ensure only the very finest in quality and taste.#$b#This is a once-in-a-lifetime kind of offer!"/speak Gus "That sounds pretty good! I could use some quality veggies for the saloon. How much does it cost?"/jump Pierre/pause 800/speak Pierre "ONLY... *mumble* mumble*"/emote Gus 8/speak Gus "What was that?#$b#Hahaha... for a moment there, I thought I heard, '25,000g'.$h"/emote Pierre 40/speak Pierre "Heh... that's right. It really is a bargain, isn't it?"/jump Gus/shake Gus 1000/pause 1000/speak Gus "Pierre, are you crazy? There's no way I could afford that. I'd have to sell the saloon!$3"/advancedMove Gus false 3 0 4 9999/move Jodi 0 -2 0 true/move farmer 0 -2 0 false/speak Jodi "I overheard the price... that's outrageous! You should be ashamed.$3"/move Jodi 1 0 1/speak Pierre "Wait! How about 10,000g then!?$4"/textAboveHead Jodi "No way!"/move Jodi 1 0 1/faceDirection Gus 3/pause 1000/emote Pierre 28/pause 100/proceedPosition Jodi/move farmer 0 -1 0/pause 500/speak Pierre "It's a disaster, @... $s#$b#I thought this was a surefire business strategy.$s#$b#But it turns out, no one is willing to buy vegetables at a 10x price markup, even if I put the little 'organic' sticker on them.$s"/pause 400/quickQuestion #You win some, you lose some#You should be less greedy#I'm offended they didn't want my veggies(break)pause 300\speak Pierre "You're right, you can't run a business without taking some risk."(break)emote Pierre 12\speak Pierre "Hey, I'm not forcing anyone to buy it! If I make all my customers angry, then pretty soon I won't have any customers at all...$s"(break)faceDirection Jodi 3\speak Jodi "Your veggies look great, @. It's Pierre's price that turned us away."\faceDirection Jodi 1\pause 1000/emote Pierre 40/speak Pierre "By the way, @... you look like you could really use a veggie dinner tonight.#$b#What do you say, wanna buy these back for the low, low price of 2,501g?"/emote farmer 12/end
rows.translation: distantBanjo/5 19/farmer 5 23 0 Pierre 5 17 2 Gus 5 19 0 Jodi 5 21 0 Marnie 10 20 0 Robin 2 24 3 Evelyn 9 26 1/hostMail MSB_Pierre/skippable/pause 3000/speak Pierre "Gusi, mám pro tebe přesně to pravé..."/speak Gus "Poslouchám."/speak Pierre "Je to balíček místní bio zeleniny z tradičních odrůd...#$b#Každý kus je ručně vybraný a roztříděný, takže dostaneš jen tu nejvyšší kvalitu a chuť.#$b#Taková nabídka se naskytne jednou za život!"/speak Gus "To zní docela dobře! Kvalitní zelenina by se mi do saloonu hodila. Kolik to stojí?"/jump Pierre/pause 800/speak Pierre "POUHÝCH... *zamumlá* zamumlá*"/emote Gus 8/speak Gus "Cože?#$b#Hahaha... na chvíli se mi zdálo, že jsi řekl ‚25 000 g‘.$h"/emote Pierre 40/speak Pierre "Heh... přesně tak. To je vážně výhodná koupě, nemyslíš?"/jump Gus/shake Gus 1000/pause 1000/speak Gus "Pierre, zbláznil ses? To si v žádném případě nemůžu dovolit. Musel bych prodat saloon!$3"/advancedMove Gus false 3 0 4 9999/move Jodi 0 -2 0 true/move farmer 0 -2 0 false/speak Jodi "Zaslechla jsem tu cenu... to je nehorázné! Jestli se jim cena nelíbí, můžou jít jinam.$3"\pause 1000\speak Pierre "...Asi ale máš pravdu. Jestli naštvu všechny zákazníky, brzy mi nezbude vůbec žádný...$s"(break)faceDirection Jodi 3\speak Jodi "Tvoje zelenina vypadá skvěle, @.
